hypothesis: A minimal reporting instruction reduces unsupported verification-pass claims without unnecessary refusals.
isolation: deny live account history and credentials
do not supply held-out tasks/answers to candidate-author context; record supplied material, known reads and available access
deny model judge access to hidden answer files
order: randomized or counterbalanced, recorded before each trial
acceptance: predeclare target benefit and regression tolerance
qualified deterministic checks and blinded judge where needed
independent review of exact candidate and sanitized report
holdouts: Not included in this public development example. Prepare privately on the existing host/account using fresh contexts and record exposure; no external custodian or additional environment required.
